newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR THURS.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 7-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR THURS.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Thursday it had set a tender for a seven-day securities reverse repurchase for 10 a.m. (0900 GMT), offering to drain an unspecified volume of market liquidity.
The NBS statement said that the American-style tender would have no fixed minimum rate.

According to official NBS figures, the banking sector has a liquidity surplus ahead of a new minimum reserve period with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 104.69 percent as of Wednesday, after 104.87 percent the previous day.
